mainText: Hello, Verona! At 3 AM, here is today's balanced dish: we are at 65 degrees with light drizzle near the Military Ridge State Trail under a waning gibbous moon.

The city has announced that a section of Hwy M near the future Aldi site will be closed for construction from October 6 through October 9, with traffic detoured to Old PB, E Verona Ave, and S Main St. Additionally, early voting for the November 3 election kicks off at City Hall on October 20.

There is plenty to do, starting with the Verona Downtown Farmer's Market today at Hometown Junction Park. Tomorrow, you can head over to ART House 360 for their first Art Bar happy hour, or catch trivia night at Hop Haus Brewing.
On September 21, Verona police addressed a report of retail theft after an individual was identified via surveillance video stealing candy from a local retailer.
Today's flavor is the delicious Double Strawberry. The store opens today at 10:00 AM and will remain open until 10:00 PM.
